shortDescription: Demonstrates a flight crew scheduling problem with skills, availability and home bases.
longDescription: Rosters crew members onto crew seats across flights between airports over one week. The flights form out-and-back rotations from two hubs, London Heathrow and Brussels, and every seat asks for either a pilot or a flight attendant. Once solved, each crew member holds the skill their seat requires, never flies two overlapping flights or flies on a day they are unavailable, only boards a flight departing from where they last landed, and starts and ends their week at their own home airport.
